description: Kindle Voyage (7th generation), stock firmware 5.13.6. Root read-only probes and an offline unpack of the official update.bin filled the readings that were complete. Not installable: the runtime machine id was not collected, /proc/bootmode was empty, and identity_ready stays false.
supported_zh: Kindle Voyage（第 7 代），固件 5.13.6。eips、uname、命令行、分区起点和四个原厂函数体已有证据。这个构建仍不能安装：运行时机器号没有采集，/proc/bootmode 为空。
supported_en: Kindle Voyage (7th generation), firmware 5.13.6. eips, uname, the command line, partition starts and the four stock function bodies have evidence. This build still cannot be installed: the runtime machine id was not collected and /proc/bootmode was empty.

measured.stock_cmdline: rootwait log_pos_goal=0x8fff0000 console=ttymxc0,115200 root=/dev/mmcblk0p1 ro ip=off quiet video=mxcepdcfb:E60,bpp=8,x_mem=3M

partition_table.ro_note: sysfs ro=0 is the block read-only flag. The root filesystem is mounted read-only. Those are not the same fact, and neither one authorizes writing mmcblk0p1 or the boot partitions.
partition_table.starts_note: start was read for mmcblk0p1..p4 only. The whole disk and the boot nodes have no start in the extra probe by design.

measured.stock_functions_source: Offline format parse of the official update_kindle_voyage_5.13.6.bin (download SHA-256 80856a11…7a155b; that hash is integrity of the downloaded file, not an RSA signature check). KindleTool extract unpacked SP01→FB03 Recovery V2 without --unsigned and without modifying signatures. uImage sha256 add9b0a29a769c241144bf245de2b94848d24aabb5765662714d0afde5a9ca32 (IH_NAME Linux-3.0.35-lab126, load 0x80008000, uncompressed). zImage payload sha256 934302ee62ff8eea3aa41f1c2c5fef465e28590567573b7eaab084158c35e74e. Inflated Image sha256 bb15c17193f8a3b8dba3d27433fd7e6322ac013defcbff5c950ceee703f76530 contains the exact device banner Linux version 3.0.35-lab126 (builder@eink-builds) (gcc version 4.9.1 (GCC) ) #2 PREEMPT Thu Apr 8 09:39:57 UTC 2021. Bodies are SHA-256 of each symbol through the next kallsyms address, file offset = addr - 0xc0008000. Not the rebuilt Android kernel. Extracted code was not executed.

device_probe.cmdline_withheld: The first probe redacted log_pos_goal and ip. The extra probe later kept allow-listed values; measured.stock_cmdline uses that second report.
device_probe.capacity_note: The owner states the chip is 4 GB and USB shows about 3.3 GB. mmcblk0 is 3959422976 bytes. mmcblk0p4 is 3269459968 bytes. The mounted FAT is 3265167360 bytes total and had 73515008 bytes free. None of these is 3 GB of free space.

device_probe_extra.bootmode_note: error: bootmode empty. The file existed and read as empty. That is not main and is not written into any handoff field.
device_probe_extra.machine_id_note: No proc file publishes only the numeric machine id. /proc/atags also carries the board id and MAC, so it was not read. mach-types 4091 stays under source only.
device_probe_extra.cmdline_kept: rootwait log_pos_goal=0x8fff0000 console=ttymxc0,115200 root=/dev/mmcblk0p1 ro ip=off quiet video=mxcepdcfb:E60,bpp=8,x_mem=3M
device_probe_extra.wifi_note: Airplane mode: modules were not loaded. Candidate ordinary files exist with the sizes above. That is not a confirmed runtime driver path.

source.firmware_note: Official update.bin, magic SP01, cert 2, inner FB03 Recovery V2, target OTA 3731990038. KindleTool extract (format parse; download SHA-256 is not RSA verification) yields imx60_wario/uImage matching the device uname banner. Signatures were not stripped or altered. Extracted blobs were not executed.
source.mach_types_note: arch/arm/tools/mach-types in the GPL member names mx6sl_wario as 4091. That is a source fact. It is not copied into measured.machine_id and is not sufficient to hand off.
source.bootmode_source_note: arch/arm/mach-mx6/boardid.c publishes /proc/bootmode from idme system_bootmode. An empty read is not main. No ordinary rootfs file replaces a runtime reading.
source.machine_id_source_note: Handoff compares __machine_arch_type to TARGET_MACHINE. No proc file publishes only that number. /proc/atags also carries board id and MAC. Expanding to boot partitions or memory is not done in this round.
source.phys_offset_note: arch/arm/plat-mxc/include/mach/memory.h defines MX6SL_PHYS_OFFSET as 0x80000000 and, under CONFIG_ARCH_MX6, selects MX6_PHYS_OFFSET 0x10000000. board-mx6sl_wario.c (pristine sha256 1091ae64f576d26e51d30949d30a04f53c2e51783b69d167229cce2759d5c563) uses MX6SL_PHYS_OFFSET for boot_params. The handoff does not adopt either address.
source.patches_note: On 2026-11-12 every patch under patches/*.patch and patches/android-core/*.patch applied with tools/apply-patch-series.py onto a fresh tree of this member. That is a source result, not a boot.
